stories.title: Anthropic researcher resigns amid AI safety concerns
stories.summary: A researcher at the AI company Anthropic resigned with a warning that the entire artificial intelligence industry is designing tools that humans will soon lose control of.

stories.title: Republicans kick off unconventional midterm convention in Dallas with Trump speech
stories.summary: Republicans' first midterm convention, being touted as a "Trumpapalooza" by the Republican Party chairman, kicks off in Dallas with a program focused heavily on tax cuts and border security.

stories.title: It's been 23 years since an American man last won the U.S. Open. That may change soon
stories.summary: An American man is guaranteed to make the final of the U.S. Open after Ben Shelton's win over defending champion Carlos Alcaraz in the quarterfinals. Shelton faces American Frances Tiafoe next.

stories.title: Trump officials propose sweeping changes to the census that would reshape voting maps
stories.summary: A Trump census proposal would stop asking about race and exclude millions of U.S. residents from a count that the 14th Amendment says must include the "whole number of persons in each state."

stories.title: A huge 11th-century tapestry of the Norman Conquest has (carefully) traveled to Engla
stories.summary: Part war propaganda, part comic strip, the 230-foot Bayeux Tapestry is back in England for the first time in 900 years. It depicts the 1066 Battle of Hastings, which ended Anglo-Saxon rule.

stories.title: Are we any closer to detecting dark matter?
stories.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with theoretical astrophysicist Priyamvada Natarajan of Yale University about a strange blip recorded by a dark matter detector in South Dakota and what the fluke could mean.
